wing_name: Remote-Access Site, Then a Program Download (Behaviour)
description: One person visits a remote-access service's site (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, ScreenConnect, RustDesk and others in UBA's site categories) and, within one hour, downloads a program. UBA rules: browser_visit_remote_access then browser_download_executable. Helpdesk support sessions look the same; the question is whether the person was expecting one.
proves: A person downloaded a program soon after visiting a remote-access service
author: Crow-Eye Team
